title: GitHub Fine-grained personal access token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: GITHUB_PAT_ vs the documented lowercase github_pat_ (case of the documented prefix changed; every cited rule is case-sensitive on the prefix), prefix: github-pat_ (hyphen for the first underscore) vs the documented github_pat_; no source or GitHub code issues or matches github-pat_, and prefix: github_pat with its trailing underscore removed, so segment 1 follows the prefix directly (every cited rule and GitHub-owned redactor requires github_pat_), and 1 more. Twin of "GitHub Fine-grained personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of github-fine-grained-pat-bearer-header: prefix: GITHUB_PAT_ vs the documented lowercase github_pat_ (case of the documented prefix changed; every cited rule is case-sensitive on the prefix). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
